build_modelopt_nvfp4_transformer: build an SGLang-loadable ModelOpt NVFP4 diffusion transformer with optional BF16 fallback modules
build_modelopt_nvfp4_flux1: build an SGLang-loadable ModelOpt NVFP4 FLUX.1-dev transformer with validated BF16 fallback patterns
build_modelopt_nvfp4_custom_patterns: build an SGLang-loadable ModelOpt NVFP4 transformer using custom keep-bf16 glob patterns
build_modelopt_nvfp4_swap_nibbles: build an SGLang-loadable ModelOpt NVFP4 transformer with swap_weight_nibbles control
build_modelopt_nvfp4_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a ModelOpt NVFP4 export into an SGLang-loadable mixed precision checkpoint
